findings.finding: O(N*M) unindexed nested loop: 1,430 stops scanning 21,554 candidate objects (30.8M comparisons) without geographic blocking.
findings.replacement: Spatial grid index (0.1 deg lat/lon bins) + region partition to prune 95% of candidates before similarity scoring.

findings.finding: Ad-hoc floating-point weighting formula (effective_sim * 45.0 * p_weight + 30.0 + 15.0 + 10.0 >= 52.0) creates decorative precision.
findings.replacement: Deterministic tiered matching cascade: exact name+corridor -> generic category+corridor -> high token overlap.

findings.finding: Candidate objects pool only ingested basic transit and place nodes, ignoring amenity=police, hospital, clinic, fuel, railway, school in OSM and latest B1.2 civic services.
findings.replacement: Expand candidate ingestion to include all high-value civic POI classes (police, hospital, fuel, college, bus stand) mapped to known stops.

findings.finding: Two separate scripts copying 60 lines of Overpass HTTP boilerplate.
findings.replacement: Consolidate into single shared fetcher or inline Overpass query utility.

findings.finding: Emitted 7 individual JSON reports where 3 core operational artifacts carry 98% of actionable data.
findings.replacement: Keep required core reports (c5_stop_resolution, coverage, manual_queue, topology) and remove dead/redundant fields.

findings.finding: Test 4 asserts on exact string prefixes in a hardcoded whitelist rather than verifying the invariant that candidates are physical objects.
findings.replacement: Assert candidate_object_type in ALLOWED_PHYSICAL_TYPES and candidate_source is non-empty and non-interpolated.

findings.finding: Redundant provenance structures generated on every execution for unchanged canonical stops.
findings.replacement: Store compact single-provenance record for candidate inferences.

findings.finding: Multi-tier consensus engine with complex decay half-lives specified before passenger app telemetry client exists.
findings.replacement: Keep specification lean: smallest viable observation schema + 3-tier consensus ladder + opt-in privacy.

findings.finding: Delete entire staging and regenerate from raw scratch.
findings.replacement: Do not delete working logic; enhance resolution cascade and geometry generation directly.

findings.finding: Reduce 20 tests to a single smoke test.
findings.replacement: Reject: O-TRAVELZ truth and multi-dimensional contract requirements necessitate comprehensive property tests for stops, anchors, and arithmetic.
